location.label: Southern California
location.detail: Building VivanceData and taking on a few AI consulting projects.

building.title: VivanceData
building.note: Small AI systems for trades and field operations: after-hours calls answered and booked, permits and delivery paperwork read instead of re-keyed.

building.title: Monkey SMP
building.note: A modded Minecraft factions server on Fabric and 26.2, packaged so anyone can host it from one download. Season I opens on 7 November.

building.title: Patina & Chime
building.note: A small Fabric mod where copper ages into different jobs and amethyst responds to music. Out now for Minecraft 26.2.

building.title: The repo fleet
building.note: Scheduled agents open pull requests across my repositories rather than pushing. merge-gate decides what merges, and I review what it holds back.

building.title: An EP
building.note: In progress. It will be on the music page when it is out.

thinkingAbout: Whether self-hosting is a technical preference or a political one, and what changes if it is the second.
How much of what gets called productivity is really just legibility to someone else.
Tools that degrade gracefully when the company behind them disappears.
Why the interesting part of a recommendation system is what it refuses to show you.
